about: Greetings. You have entered the domain of the one true xXSephirothXx (there are 6 others on this site's search results. they are pretenders). I have completed Final Fantasy VII nine (9) times, including once with the sound off so I could hear the story in my SOUL. I am currently writing a 40-part essay series on the Jenova problem. Part 7 is where it gets controversial. My masamune is a yardstick with electrical tape on it and it is MAGNIFICENT. Do not speak to me of Advent Children spoilers. I have seen it 14 times. I AM the spoiler.
